skills.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. EDIT the attached skill icon into a cohesive MODERN URBAN contemporary street martial-arts game icon. Output ONE 1024x1024 square PNG. Preserve the input's exact assigned dominant hue, skill meaning, core composition, gesture orientation and square framing. Completely replace the old weathered fantasy metal rendering: clean contemporary editorial game illustration, smooth matte surfaces, precise bold outlines, restrained two-to-three-tone cel shading, slight soft depth, crisp controlled colored accent light on charcoal-black background. Modern athletic equipment and street training clothes, simplified pictographic rendering, NOT a photo or product advertisement. Remove ALL scratches, hammered grain, stone textures, metallic reflections, silver edges, medieval armor, plate gauntlets, knight boots, rivets, gemstones, fantasy ornament. No robots, powered armor or cybernetic limbs. No text, logos, letters, numerals or watermark. Large instantly readable central emblem, black negative space, no cityscape added. Replace frame material with smooth matte-black polymer, same square clipped-corner silhouette. Uniform thickness about 4 percent with clean colored inset lines. Corner ornaments become FLAT graphic line marks, diamond details if present become printed geometric marks, never jewels. Fill entire canvas without exterior margin. LOWEST/BASIC tier: keep ONE colored inset outline and four small flat clipped corner tabs, minimal central detailing. CRIMSON RED. Keep upward-right punch. Replace metal fist and vambrace with a human fist wrapped in clean red cotton boxing handwraps and a short black athletic cuff. Clearly fabric bands, bare fingertips optional, NO rigid armor. Keep three flat red impact ticks and short clean red motion wedge.
